meta.title: Skip vendor review with pro-rata allocation of global charges
gaps: The catalog has no dedicated step to identify a Lot RFQ with a pending Lot Adjustment or assert the exact pro-rata lot charge values independently.

plan.title: Skip vendor review with pro-rata lot charge allocation

steps.note: Open the most relevant existing event for the Lot RFQ workflow.

args.goal: On the opened buyer event, locate the vendor card with a pending Lot Adjustment, click Skip Vendor Review, choose Pro-rata allocation by line item value or quantity, enter the reason "Vendor not responding", click Confirm & Skip Review, and stop only when the screen proves that the vendor review was skipped and the vendor's lot charges reflect the pro-rata split.

steps.note: Perform and observe the lot review skip flow, including allocation mode, reason, confirmation, and resulting charge distribution.
Ensure the resulting screen has no crash, server error, NaN, undefined, or raw identifiers after the review is skipped.
